history: All actual failed build/test command receipts remain; no old test or frozen expected row was rewritten.

items.detail: Standalone original title slice initially used VBC default Binary, unlike Windows OptionCompare Text. V1 capture4480 rows remains immutable and explicitly invalid for procedure text comparison. V2 compiled the same frozen source with /optioncompare:text before production edits;1120 comparisons against actual original private Windows adapters pass. New Common title policy explicitly uses Option Compare Text.
A new IReadOnlyList Count(predicate) expression was corrected to Where(predicate).Count(). No product behavior changed.

Direct test calls exposing embedded Excel Chart/Worksheet types were replaced with reflection of existing entry points and null guards. No interop reference, production signature or native execution changed.

New mutation test initially expected a missing threshold table cell to be Nothing. Independent original projection output shows numeric zero from VB conditional type inference; the new test now protects that unchanged C25 candidate and separately asserts actual missing SMD cells are Nothing.
